notes:
Fault scan: a module no longer shows hundreds of faults. Like BMW's own tester, only stored and pending faults count; older entries are counted on the module's line.
New free trial: one car for 24 hours, counted from when you first connect your car. The trial time shows on the licence card, and when it is over every screen says so.
When your trial ends you get a personal lifetime offer on the payment page.
E-Sys error messages now say what they mean and what to do, right in E-Sys's own message window.
New: Flashing > Last job report shows E-Sys's last job in plain words: every module, the step it stopped at and why.
NCD compare is now on the toolbar, right after Backup.
After Disconnect, E-Sys MAX tells you when the ignition is on again.
Typed values in Keys are checked before they are used.
The Terms now show the support each plan includes.
Small fixes.
